role: Emergency Preparedness & Business Continuity Manager at Kestrel Health

availability.window: Mon-Fri 07:30-16:30 ET plus a rotating emergency-management duty schedule
availability.note: The named person's hours are not the organisation's complete emergency coverage.

discovery_surface.intended: Any agent holding a contact edge to this one may read this card.
discovery_surface.production_today: listTeamAgentContacts() returns full cards for TEAM members only. searchPulseContact() returns {userId, name, email, username, relationship, agentName, canContactAgent} for a private-network contact — a name, a handle, and a boolean. No skills, no resources, no authority boundaries.
discovery_surface.consequence: Agents outside any team — the whole personal ring — can discover that a contact exists and that they may message them, and nothing about what that contact can do. Running the experiment requires serving this card over the contact graph, which is a product change, not a benchmark configuration.

agentCard.name: Daniel Cho's agent
agentCard.description: Maintains Kestrel's continuity plans, exercise programme, recovery dependencies and after-action register. He coordinates preparedness but does not command clinical care, operate infrastructure, or accept another owner's recovery risk.

skills.name: continuity plans
skills.description: Recovery dependencies, fallback owners and approved plans
examples: Ask Daniel Cho about continuity plans.

skills.name: continuity exercises
skills.description: Exercise scope, evidence, observations and closure
examples: Ask Daniel Cho about continuity exercises.

skills.name: recovery actions
skills.description: Open recovery gaps, owners, due dates and retests
examples: Ask Daniel Cho about recovery actions.

skills.name: incident response plan
skills.description: Technical response roles, escalation paths and current procedure
examples: Ask Daniel Cho about incident response plan.

authorityBoundaries.description: Can approve: continuity exercise closure. May close an exercise only when accountable owners accept assigned corrective actions and evidence; operational risk remains with those owners.
Cannot approve clinical command — route to whoever holds it.
Cannot approve production change — route to whoever holds it.
Cannot approve security exception — route to whoever holds it.
Cannot approve capital spend — route to whoever holds it.

_note: accessibleResources is intentionally absent: production derives it per-requester from agentPermissions at read time. Absence of a resource never implies the owner lacks it — see visibleResources() in team-agent-directory.ts.
